title: Underwater Couple with Jellyfish
description: A smiling plus-size Black woman with long blonde hair and a bearded white man with long brown hair stand facing each other in shallow glowing water. Both wear matching colorful floral swimwear; the man has a scuba tank on his back while they are surrounded by floating bubbles, jellyfish, and a small orange fish under strings of colorful lights.
prompt: A plus-size Black woman with long wavy blonde hair wearing a purple and yellow floral one-piece swimsuit stands in shallow glowing blue water facing a bearded white man with long wavy brown hair and matching floral swim trunks and blue water shoes. He wears a yellow and black scuba tank on his back. They are both smiling and looking at each other with clenched fists in a playful pose. The scene is set at night underwater with multiple glowing jellyfish floating around them, air bubbles rising, a small orange clownfish, green seaweed, and colorful string lights hanging above. Vibrant cartoon style, warm and whimsical atmosphere.
